comment: Pinned upstream sources for the skill-authoring development toolchain. Nothing here is a runtime dependency of the `jev` binary, and nothing here is committed: scripts/skill-authoring-setup.sh clones each repository at the pinned commit into the gitignored references/ corpus and copies the listed artifacts into the gitignored .claude/skills/ paths. See docs/development/skill-authoring.md.

anthropics/skills.licenseNote: No repository-root LICENSE. skills/skill-creator/LICENSE.txt is Apache-2.0 with the copyright line filled in: Copyright 2026 Anthropic, PBC.

install.why: Primary skill-authoring orchestrator: drafting, eval prompts, baseline and with-skill runs, independent grading, benchmark aggregation, blind A/B comparison, analyzer subagents, and held-out trigger-description optimization.

obra/superpowers.licenseNote: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Jesse Vincent. The repository LICENSE is copied next to each installed skill.

install.why: Secondary methodology: skill authoring as red-green-refactor, with the baseline run and the pressure scenarios that make a failure observable before a skill is written.
Declared prerequisite of writing-skills; it defines the red-green-refactor cycle writing-skills builds on.
Stops a skill being called done because its Markdown validates. Self-contained, no cross-references.
Parallel research, independent eval execution, adversarial testing, and review. Self-contained, no cross-references.

agentskills/agentskills.licenseNote: docs/specification.mdx is the portability authority for the skills this repository ships. skills-ref/ is Apache-2.0 and is described upstream as demonstration software, not production software.
agentskills/agentskills.referenceOnly: Read in place. The specification's rules are enforced by scripts/validate-skills.py; skills-ref is not installed and is not a dependency.

anthropics/claude-plugins-official.licenseNote: Repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0 with an unfilled copyright placeholder; plugins/skill-creator/.claude-plugin/plugin.json names Anthropic as the author.
anthropics/claude-plugins-official.referenceOnly: plugins/skill-creator is byte-identical to anthropics/skills except for its LICENSE.txt copyright line, so only one copy is installed. plugins/plugin-dev/skills/skill-development is deliberately NOT installed: it overlaps skill-creator and its description competes for the same trigger.
